decisions.decision: Per-pair fields save on blur, not per keystroke
decisions.rationale: Avoids DB write on every keystroke; mirrors handleNotesBlur pattern from DoctorReportPage

decisions.decision: isActive badge on Meaning detail is read-only (aggregated from pairs)
decisions.rationale: Meaning.isActive = true if ANY linked pair.isActive is true; only changeable via per-pair Switch

decisions.decision: Date inputs use <input type="date"> not Calendar popover
decisions.rationale: Consistent with onboarding birth date pattern; avoids Popover complexity
